answer: Border stamps tell the truth about a person in a way no form can fake: a passport stamp history with border authority attestation shows years of real crossings, each one logged by an officer at a real checkpoint. A raven of forged documents falls apart against the border database, because every stamp has a matching entry. The plume of effort is enormous - a falcon cannot fly through a checkpoint without leaving a record - and a thousand fake accounts would need a thousand real journeys.
